event.headline: We resolved a compatibility issue
event.summary: We detected a change that threatened order processing. We resolved it and verified all 4 orders from the affected period against NetSuite.

facts.label: Change detected
facts.value: Shopify changed the order data it sends (format 2026-10 → 2027-01): the unit price of each order line is no longer where your integration reads it.

facts.label: Why it mattered
facts.value: Orders could have been created in NetSuite without the unit price of each order line. We held them instead of writing them.

facts.label: Action taken
facts.value: We updated how your integration reads the unit price of each order line to match Shopify’s new format. Before switching it on, we confirmed it changes nothing for 2 earlier orders and gives the same values as Shopify’s own records for 2 affected orders.

facts.label: Transactions affected
facts.value: 3 orders: 2 held safely and delivered after the fix; 1 never reached us and was found by checking Shopify directly.

facts.label: Final outcome
facts.value: All 4 orders created in the affected period are in NetSuite exactly once, with the items, quantities and prices Shopify has for them.

claim.basis: Every order Shopify has for the affected period (23 Nov 2026, 22:03:05–22:03:49 UTC) was checked in NetSuite after the fix.

timeline.title: Investigated
timeline.text: We traced the change to the part of your integration that reads the unit price of each order line and confirmed that, left alone, it would have produced incorrect sales orders.

timeline.title: Fix tested
timeline.text: We tested the fix against earlier orders and against Shopify’s own records of the affected orders before switching it on.

timeline.title: Held orders delivered
